newsitem.title: UK: HSBC's Saudi Brit bank H1 profits rise.
newsitem.headline: HSBC's Saudi Brit bank H1 profits rise.

text.p: The Saudi British Bank, part of Britain's HSBC Holdings Plc, said on Monday its net profits for the six months to June 30, 1997 rose 17.1 percent to 269.7 million Saudi riyals ($71.9 million).
The bank's customer base was up 9.7 percent to 22.5 billion riyals while investment securities rose 23.5 percent to 16.8 billion riyals, it said.
The Saudi bank's managing director, Sandy Flockhart, said the results were in line with its forecast. ---London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366 ($ = 3.750 Saudi Arabian Riyals).
